prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create VAPOREON-PING, Pokémon Vaporeon transformed into a tiny magical Catch! Teenieping-style character in the MyStarQuest project's polished 3D style.
Reference roles: Image 1 is Vaporeon, the authoritative source for identity, colors and signature features. Image 2 is Heartping, the reference for giant rounded head, miniature upright body, expressive eyes, sculpted hair and Teenieping rendering. Image 3 is the recently designed Primarina-Ping, supporting reference for finish and aquatic-character integration ONLY; do not copy its mermaid anatomy, pearls, pink star or ponytail.
Make a recognizable Teenie Ping FIRST while unmistakably preserving Vaporeon: huge softly squared rounded aqua-blue head (about 60 percent of height), enormous glossy deep ocean-blue eyes with violet undertones and sparkling white catchlights, tiny dark button nose, rosy cheeks, small happy open smile. Tiny upright turquoise body with TWO short arms and TWO stubby separate feet. One hand waves in a cute friendly pose. Keep Vaporeon's large outward-spreading triangular fin ears with pale cream membranes and dark teal ribs/edges. Preserve the dark teal crown-like cap and central tall tapering forehead fin; translate part of the cap into a sculpted soft wave-shaped forelock to echo Teenieping hair while retaining the original center fin. Preserve the distinctive white pleated circular neck ruff, softly rounded and pearly, framing the tiny shoulders.
A long aqua fish tail emerges from behind the body, curls clearly beside the feet, and ends in Vaporeon's signature two-lobed fish fluke. Dark teal small dorsal ridges run along back and upper tail. The tail is an ADDITION to the two little legs, not a mermaid lower body. Put a small white oval belly patch with a tasteful gold royal crown emblem, consistent with the project Teeniepings. Smooth aquatic skin, not fur.
Premium polished 3D children's animation, gentle gloss and soft subsurface shading, sculpted rounded forms, enchanting expressive face and friendly playful mood. Colors: aqua turquoise, dark teal, pearly white and pale cream. Keep Vaporeon's fin-ear silhouette, forehead crest, white collar and fish tail highly readable. No generic human princess, no adult proportions, no long animal muzzle, no quadruped pose.
Single centered full-body character in nearly frontal three-quarter view. Entire ears, tall crest, waving hand, both feet and tail fluke fully visible with a generous transparent margin. Genuine transparent background, no water scenery or ground plane. No wand, extra character, text, logo, frame or watermark.
